effects.description: Sets targets alight, burning for a quarter of the hit every second for 3 s.
Slows targets. Three hits freeze them solid for 2.5 s.
Lightning arcs to another target within 6 m for 60% damage.
Stacks up to 5 times, each stack dealing 12% of the hit every second for 5 s.
35% chance the attack repeats itself a moment later at 60% power.
25% chance to implode, pulling in and hurting everything within 1.8 m.
Stacks up to 3 times, each stack bleeding 15% of the hit every second for 4 s.
Half of hits, and every heavy attack, knock targets off their feet for 0.6 s.
Double damage against targets below 30% health.
20% of damage dealt comes back as mana.
Fires two more projectiles in a spread, at 60% damage.
Projectiles go through up to 2 targets.
Projectiles explode where they land, hurting everything within 2.2 m for 70%.
Projectiles curve towards targets in front of them.
40% of hits root targets to the spot for 1.6 s; they can still strike out.
Projectiles glance off what they hit to the nearest other within 9 m, at 70%.

synergies.title: Eclipse
synergies.description: Hitting a burning target consumes the flames in a void explosion. Burning targets it kills explode too, up to 3 in a row.

synergies.title: Stormcaller
synergies.description: Lightning chains through up to 4 targets, each jump hitting 25% harder, up to double.

synergies.title: Widowmaker
synergies.description: Critical hits on bleeding targets siphon three times as much. Killing a bleeding target sends you into a frenzy: 40% faster attacks for 5 s.

synergies.title: Frostbite
synergies.description: Hitting a frozen target shatters the ice for 2.5x damage, chilling everything within 2.5 m.

synergies.title: Gravewhisper
synergies.description: Poisoned targets burst into a toxic cloud when they die, poisoning everything within 3 m, up to 3 in a row.

ammo.description: Wide barbed heads that tear as they go in, and keep tearing.
Oiled rags bound behind the head, set alight as they're loosed.
Heads of rime-iron, leaving a bitter cold in the wound.
Grooved heads filled with spider venom.
A clay pot of black powder behind the head, bursting where it lands.
Long narrow steel points that punch through hide and mail.
Broad barbed heads that can't be pulled out clean.
Pitch-soaked tow wound behind the head, lit as the latch lets go.
Shafts of frozen ash tipped with rime-iron.
Hollow heads that break open in the wound.
Copper-bound heads that carry a spark from one foe to the next.
A charge of powder in an iron sleeve behind the head, going off where it strikes.
Hardened square points for armor, and whatever's behind it.
Knobs of turned iron for heads, to knock down rather than cut.
A forked head like a new moon, for hamstringing whatever runs.
A weighted net furled behind a blunt head, bursting open over what it strikes.
Hard, polished points that skip off what they hit and on into the next.
Three slim bolts bound as one, parting as they leave the groove.
Fletched with owl feathers and bound with a rune that finds its mark.
Obsidian heads that tear a little hole in the world where they strike.
Hollow crescents that drink what they spill.
Gilded points blessed to finish what's already falling.
A paper cartridge of small shot, spraying out in a cone.
Rough-cast iron, all edges, that tears going in.
Balls rolled in fire-salts that leave the barrel burning.
Lead cast round a shard of ice that never melts.
Hollow balls of soft lead, full of venom.
A small iron grenade instead of a ball, its fuse lit by the powder. A spread of shot fires one.
A hardened steel core that goes through armor, and what's behind it.
Flattened balls that skip off what they hit and on into the next.
Owl-fletched, a rune cut in each head that finds its mark.
